procedures.title: Er t4: Fresh-food evaporator defrost sensor
procedures.purpose: Service mode test 31: FF evaporator defrost sensor

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before resistance checks or harness service. R-600a is flammable — follow sealed-system precautions when applicable.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power cord before servicing this appliance.

steps.title: Harness and pin backouts
steps.body: Check fresh-food evaporator defrost sensor harness for pin backouts, pinched or damaged wires before replacing parts. Reseat connector at main control board.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Repair or replace harness when damaged or loose.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Check fresh-food evaporator defrost sensor harness for pin backouts, pinched or damaged wires before replacing parts. Reseat connector at main control board.

steps.title: Repair harness
steps.body: Repair wiring or reseat connector, then retest in service mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Repair wiring or reseat connector, then retest in service mode.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: System Diagnostic Mode entered. Navigate to the sensor test number for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After service mode entry, proceed with OEM sensor readout and resistance checks.

steps.title: Service mode test 31 readout
steps.body: In System Diagnostic Mode, navigate to test 31 (FF evaporator defrost sensor). Display should show compartment temperature — not OP (open) or SH (short).

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: OP/SH indicates open or shorted sensor circuit.

steps.sourceExcerpt: In System Diagnostic Mode, navigate to test 31 (FF evaporator defrost sensor). Display should show compartment temperature — not OP (open) or SH (short).

steps.title: FF evaporator defrost sensor resistance
steps.body: Power off. Measure FF evaporator defrost sensor NTC at harness — typical 5–16 kΩ at room temperature. Contact TID before main board replacement per service data sheet.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Measure FF evaporator defrost sensor NTC at harness — typical 5–16 kΩ at room temperature. Contact TID before main board replacement per service data sheet.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Repair or replace harness when damaged or loose.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: OP/SH indicates open or shorted sensor circuit.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator before resistance checks or harness service. R-600a is flammable — follow sealed-system precautions when applicable.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power cord before servicing this appliance.

steps.title: Turn ice maker ON
steps.body: Press and hold POWER on the FFIM for ½ second until POWER illuminates solid green.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press and hold POWER on the FFIM for ½ second until POWER illuminates solid green.

steps.title: Run TEST self-diagnostic
steps.body: Press and release TEST/SERVICE. Tray performs two rotations: hold bail arm up during the first rotation (simulate full bin); release for second rotation (empty bin). POWER returns solid green if pass; rapid blink = internal IM failure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press and release TEST/SERVICE. Tray performs two rotations: hold bail arm up during the first rotation (simulate full bin); release for second rotation (empty bin). POWER returns solid green if pass; rapid blink = internal IM failure.

steps.title: Self-test passed?
steps.body: After second rotation home, is POWER solid green (no rapid blink)?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace FFIM assembly — internal failure detected.

steps.sourceExcerpt: After second rotation home, is POWER solid green (no rapid blink)?

branches.label: No / fault

steps.title: Enter manual defrost (dF)
steps.body: On main UI: hold + and Air Filter buttons for 10 seconds. Display shows dF while manual defrost is active.
steps.sourceExcerpt: On main UI: hold + and Air Filter buttons for 10 seconds. Display shows dF while manual defrost is active.

steps.title: Defrost cycle effective?
steps.body: Allow manual defrost to run. Verify evaporator frost clears and compartment temperatures recover after dF completes and unit returns to normal operation.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Manual defrost did not clear frost — continue component diagnostics.
